units.source_text: 有一天，我去神田办事，回来比平时晚了许多。

en.t: One day I went to Kanda on an errand and came back much later than usual.

units.source_text: 我急步走到门前，‘哗啦’一声拉开格子门。

en.t: I hurried to the front entrance and slid the lattice door open with a clatter.

units.source_text: 与此同时，听到了小姐的说话声。

en.t: At the same moment, I heard the young lady's voice.

units.source_text: 那声音肯定是从K的房间里传来的。

en.t: The voice was certainly coming from K's room.

units.source_text: 这个宅子的布局是，进了玄关一直走，是客厅和小姐的卧房，然后向左拐，就是K和我的房间。

en.t: The layout of the house was such that if you went straight in from the entryway, there were the sitting room and the young lady's bedroom, and if you then turned left, there were K's room and mine.

units.source_text: 住久了，我对这里已经很熟悉了，所以无论是谁，在哪个房间里发出声音，我一听就知道。

en.t: Having lived there so long, I knew the place well enough to tell at once who was speaking and from which room.

units.source_text: 我马上关上了格子门，小姐的说话声也立刻停了下来。

en.t: I closed the lattice door at once, and the young lady's voice stopped immediately too.

units.source_text: 我弯下腰解鞋带的时候——那时我为了赶时髦，穿的是那种费事的高腰系带皮鞋——

en.t: As I bent down to untie my shoelaces--in those days, trying to be fashionable, I wore those troublesome high-laced leather shoes--

units.source_text: K的房间里什么声音也没有了。

en.t: there was no sound at all from K's room.

units.source_text: 我很纳闷，心想也许是我听错了吧。

en.t: I found it strange and thought perhaps I had misheard.

units.source_text: 但是，当我像往常那样拉开隔扇要穿过K的房间时，

en.t: But when, as usual, I opened the sliding partition to pass through K's room,

units.source_text: 却看见他们两个人就坐在房间里。

en.t: I saw the two of them sitting right there in the room.
K said, as he always did, "Just got back?"

units.source_text: 小姐没有起身，也问候了一句：‘您回来啦。’

en.t: The young lady did not get up, but also greeted me, saying, "You're back."

units.source_text: 大概是心理作用吧，我觉得小姐这句简单的问候有点生硬，

en.t: Perhaps it was only my imagination, but that simple greeting from her sounded a little stiff to me,

units.source_text: 她的语调听起来不大自然。

en.t: and her tone did not sound very natural.
I asked the young lady, "Where is Madam?"

units.source_text: 我这么问并没有什么特别的意思，

en.t: There was no particular meaning in my asking this.

units.source_text: 只是发觉家里比平时安静了些随口问的。

en.t: I merely asked because I had noticed that the house was quieter than usual.
